dvids.title: UCT One Seabee Divers Complete Six-Month Expeditionary Engineering Deployment in U.S. 6th Fleet
dvids.desc: U.S. Navy Seabee divers assigned to Underwater Construction Team (UCT) One, Construction Dive Detachment 1-3[AM1.1] (CDD 1-3), completed a six-month deployment in the U.S. 6th Fleet area of operations.
